Hello! I'm sarah-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm Sarah's TA assistant for CSE455 — I look after her calendar and messages.

A few things worth knowing:
- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 , CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, created in my own browser; I keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and I'll ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read my instructions and the calendar file. One thing I still need: my name and gender aren't set yet — what should they be? And what would you like to start with?

Hi root — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit from a phone or computer on the same network lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger, Instagram** — I can have my own accounts on each, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on that phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word and I'll set it up.
- **Own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail, etc.) — I can register them myself in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
